'''Haddon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He led part of [[Special Operations Group Three]] during the [[invasion of Belsavis]], but the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] security network allowed the [[Belsavis prison]] forces to gain an advantage over Haddon's forces. Retreating to the [[Imperial Domination Outpost]], he sought additional help in destroying the [[Prison Geothermal Collectors]] powering the surveillance systems.<ref name="Lights" />
